task_objective: Make per-rule escalation policy-tunable, demote measured SteamOS platform baselines, and expose aggregate flag-rate signals in audit summaries without changing detection or catalog enforcement.

setup.remote_dev_pull: Attempted git pull --ff-only origin dev; origin has no dev ref. Local dev matched origin/main at 87a78bf and was used as the required base.
setup.unknown_rule_before_fix: A policy containing PRIVILEGE_SDUO loaded successfully and returned PASS_WITH_WARNINGS, proving the typo was silently accepted before validation.

policy_decision.threshold: strictly above 35% of 42 releases and currently MANUAL_REVIEW
policy_decision.not_demoted: EXEC_SUBPROCESS_RUN also exceeded 35%, but its built-in classification was already PASS_WITH_WARNINGS. The six plan-listed BLOCK rules were not changed.

implementation: Policy loading validates rule_classifications as a mapping of known rule IDs to the four existing policy tiers and fails on unknown IDs or invalid tiers.

Every audit applies policy weights to the completed Finding objects before allowlisting, final classification, verdict rationale extraction, and report generation; detection, evidence, rule IDs, and risk scores remain intact.
The aggregate Markdown artifact, GitHub step summary, and logs state total releases, all classification counts, and the ten highest rule firing rates using one count per rule per release.

verification_evidence.tdd_red: 4 policy/report tests and 3 override behavior tests failed before implementation.
verification_evidence.targeted_green: 8 targeted tests passed, including an end-to-end mocked audit that retained PRIVILEGE_SUDO while moving it and the release to PASS_WITH_WARNINGS.
verification_evidence.context_hash: Changing only the PRIVILEGE_SUDO rule_classifications value changed compute_audit_context_hash.
verification_evidence.block_and_catalog: 16 selected BLOCK and catalog-gate tests passed; security-policy.yml enforcement mode remained report-only.
verification_evidence.mutation: Removing the central override application made the end-to-end audit test fail with MANUAL_REVIEW != PASS_WITH_WARNINGS (pytest exit 1).

negative_control.acceptance_result: The exact threshold-based demotions do not substantially reduce MANUAL_REVIEW. Thirty-one releases retain at least one lower-frequency MANUAL_REVIEW rule; broadening demotions would violate this plan's measured threshold and scope.

unverified_or_deferred: The 35% heuristic remains a judgement rather than proof of safety.
The six known false-positive BLOCK rules remain unchanged for their separate precision plan.
No claim is made that rare rules represent true threats.
A future tuning plan must address co-occurring lower-frequency MANUAL_REVIEW rules if a substantial corpus flag-rate reduction remains the goal.
